name: TanhGatedResidualAddBackward
reference:
import torch

def run(grad_output, gate, hidden_states, mask):
    tanh_gate = torch.tanh(gate)
    grad_gate = grad_output * hidden_states * (1 - tanh_gate ** 2)
    grad_hidden = grad_output * tanh_gate
    grad_residual = grad_output.clone()
    if mask is not None:
        grad_gate = grad_gate * mask.to(grad_gate.dtype)
        grad_hidden = grad_hidden * mask.to(grad_hidden.dtype)
        grad_residual = grad_residual * mask.to(grad_residual.dtype)
    return grad_residual.to(torch.bfloat16), grad_hidden.to(torch.bfloat16), grad_gate.to(torch.bfloat16)
description: Backward pass for tanh-gated residual addition. Computes gradients w.r.t. residual, hidden_states, and gate. All outputs in bfloat16. Pure PyTorch: grad computation for x + tanh(gate) * hidden * mask.
